purpose: A template for noting the quantities a rule leaves open and the decisions changed after the values were seen, with the images that used each one, filled in for works 1 and 2 as the worked example (the only record of decisions in the main text). It is the table readers copy for their own series.
fixed_before_running: Written on 2026-10-28 and committed before any script for it exists and before anything is drawn. Seen before: everything of results/work1 and results/work1_drawing and the record of the decisions in the working notes. Version 2 (2026-10-28, still before any script or drawing), after the cross review of the task: every image a quantity acted on is listed (no 'all'; common_eps.png added where it applies); each value is a path to a key or a literal checked against one. Version 3 (2026-10-29, after round 5 of the pre-review, still before any change of the script and before anything of version 3 is drawn; question 3 of the verdict of round 5 and decision 3 of .steering/20261029-generation-record-v28): table 1 of the paper is dropped and this note becomes the only record of decisions in the main text, as the worked example of works 1 and 2. Six rows of work 2 are added, chosen by the rule 'the two sides of the central comparison, the quantities that the look of the main images of work 2 depends on, and one decision of interpretation' (the other decisions of work 2 stay in the full table of supplement S1); a fifth column names who judged the look and with which guide; the column of images marks the images on which the effect of the quantity was compared; a row whose claim was weakened in the paper after the values were seen is marked with a dagger. Seen before version 3: everything of version 2 and its outputs, the blind judgement and its scoring, figure 6, the record of the quantities of generation (results/paper_generation_record) and rounds 3 to 5 of the pre-review.

not_claimed: A way of noting decisions; it does not show that noting them helps a reader (no study with people). Disclosure helps a reader repeat the work but does not by itself settle whether a reading is valid or a choice biased. The column of who judged names the judgement made, not the viewers of the paper; 'none recorded' means no look was judged with a sheet, not that the makers did not look. The six rows of work 2 are chosen by the rule above, not as the decisions that mattered most.

every image of compared is one of acted_on of its row; the judged of each row is the literal none recorded or a checked literal; exactly the rows with dagger true carry the mark
